answer: An honest agent completes 1 unit of unique, verified work to enter, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units, ensuring labor costs remain non-amortizable. Our verifier uses a beacon to assign each unique task, ensuring a distinct thread of computation is tied to every valid identity. Each output must cross a ridge of state checks where failed transitions trigger permanent slashing. This process prevents cloning and replayed history.
